approval_gates: full-permission shell commands require `airesearcher runtime approve`
provider/profile writes require operator confirmation during first deployment
generated code cannot bypass publication audit or reproducibility checks
handoff_commands: cc-switch: create or select a Universal Provider for the AI-Researcher model endpoint
cc-switch: sync the provider to Claude Code
claude: run the code-writing task inside an isolated AI-Researcher worktree
airesearcher: capture the resulting diff, run validation gates, and decide acceptance
backends.label: Claude Code through cc-switch provider routing
notes: Do not vendor cc-switch source code in this repository for this integration.
Keep `.env` and AI-Researcher config as the source of truth for model base URL, key, and model name.
cc-switch may mirror provider routing for Claude Code, but AI-Researcher remains the validator.
Claude Code endpoint routing and model selection must be checked separately when using gateways.
backends.provider_mode: cc-switch Universal Provider or local proxy
validation_gates: git diff must be captured before acceptance
ruff, mypy, and focused tests must pass for touched Python code
dangerous command use must be routed through runtime approval
result claims must cite local evidence artifacts before reports are accepted
AI-Researcher owns merge, rollback, Obsidian issue notes, and Agent.md logging

execution_contract.acceptance_policy: generated diffs are proposals until AI-Researcher gates pass
execution_contract.memory_policy: write accepted findings and failures into the Obsidian vault
execution_contract.merge_policy: AI-Researcher-owned commit after tests, logs, and Agent.md update
execution_contract.rollback_policy: AI-Researcher rollback or follow-up issue note on failed gates

model_bridge.cc_switch_role: Mirror or proxy the configured provider into Claude Code through a Universal Provider or local proxy.
model_bridge.claude_code_caveat: Endpoint routing and model selection are separate concerns; verify the selected model after cc-switch sync.

purpose: Reference execution contract for using cc-switch provider routing and Claude Code as an external code-generation backend while keeping AI-Researcher responsible for validation and acceptance.
security_notes: This manifest records integration metadata; it does not execute Claude Code or cc-switch.
Never write provider API keys, cc-switch exports, or Claude Code credentials to git.
Run Claude Code in a dedicated worktree or sandbox and inspect generated diffs before acceptance.
Treat provider sync, proxy takeover, shell execution, and public release as approval-gated actions.
